title: Three dynamic stores with irrigation as an internal transfer

dependency_gate.implementation_rule: No DUMMY-13 model or tests before both dependencies are formally qualified and the implementation baseline is rebound.

purpose: Join the qualified analytical root-zone demand state to the dynamic surface-water/groundwater system while treating irrigation and surface-groundwater exchange as internal transfers in one three-store ledger.

frozen_first_stage_scope.irrigation_delivery: U determined by the surface-water management complementarity and transferred into root storage
frozen_first_stage_scope.surface_groundwater_exchange: V reciprocal between surface and groundwater as in DUMMY-10

hypotheses: The exact DUMMY-10 management solution can be reinterpreted as an internal surface-to-root transfer without changing its surface/groundwater algebra for a request frozen from root start state.
For every accepted window, irrigation U cancels between surface and root ledgers and exchange V cancels between surface and groundwater ledgers.
With no external forcing, total three-store water is invariant exactly.
A current-window shortage is not carried separately; the next request follows only from the accepted root storage W_r,end.
Partial delivery leaves a physical root deficit equal to the undelivered start deficit in the no-forcing first-stage problem.
If the surface/groundwater system can deliver the full root request, the accepted root storage reaches W_target exactly.
Two multi-window histories that reach the same three committed states have identical next requests and physical exchange problem regardless of their prior shortage diagnostics.
No same-window second irrigation request is created after U changes root storage.

Because DUMMY-13 declares the three stores disjoint by construction, its combined-ledger proof is conditional on that declared partition and must not be used as evidence that real SWAP and MODFLOW storage domains are non-overlapping.

In the preregistered canonical two-window sequence, the first window is CURTAILED and the second is ZERO: root storage remains 72 m3 while surface-groundwater exchange continues and lowers surface head from 0.4 to 0.36 m.

The combined three-store ledger remains invariant for negative V (groundwater-to-surface transfer), with the same single signed exchange variable entering surface and groundwater component ledgers oppositely.
interpretation_rules: irrigation is an external sink only when the root-zone recipient lies outside the modeled system boundary; once root storage is included, it is an internal transfer
system-boundary choice changes the combined ledger but must not change component flux identity
shortage remains diagnostic; root-zone state carries the physical consequence
environmental root forcing is deferred to a later work unit so the internal-transfer ledger is qualified first
The three-store dummy is a conditional control-volume oracle. Real production storage-partition authority remains owned by the F-GC coupling-semantics workstream.
forbidden: no implementation before DUMMY-11 and DUMMY-12 qualification
no rainfall, ET, root drainage, recharge or capillary rise in first-stage DUMMY-13
no use of DUMMY-13 as proof of CSR-B1 real SWAP/MODFLOW storage non-overlap or CSR-B2 drainage ownership
preregistration_revision_note: Before DUMMY-13 implementation, current canonical F-GC project control and noncanonical CSR-04 authority were reconciled. DUMMY-13's three stores are explicitly non-overlapping by construction. This makes it a ledger oracle under declared disjoint ownership, not evidence that real SWAP storage and MODFLOW STO are physically non-overlapping.

real_coupling_authority_boundary.canonical_product_state: F-GC50 is internally ready for the restricted admitted profile but actual iMOD Coupler product registration remains externally blocked.
real_coupling_authority_boundary.live_shared_authority_blocker: CSR-B1-STORAGE-PARTITION: real SWAP-derived finite-window response and MODFLOW STO require explicit independent storage-role authority/non-overlap or overlap correction.
real_coupling_authority_boundary.drainage_blocker: CSR-B2-DRAINAGE-OWNERSHIP: one owner per physical drainage path is required.
real_coupling_authority_boundary.dummy_nonclaim: Passing DUMMY-13 cannot close CSR-B1 or CSR-B2 because the dummy chooses disjoint stores and has no authentic SWAP/MODFLOW storage-domain mapping.

canonical_second_window.interpretation: After the first curtailed window lands exactly on the management threshold, reciprocal physical exchange may continue in the next window while management remains off; the root deficit persists because no irrigation is delivered.

negative_exchange.interpretation: Groundwater-to-surface exchange must cancel internally with the same ledger identity; sign reversal must not require a separate accounting convention.
